parameters.content:
## W20 Onboarding wizard (broker-success)
Spec: portal/spec/README.md (state machine, events) and portal/spec/10-nudges-and-go-live.md (copy). Timezone Africa/Johannesburg.
Lanes: A broker events (signed webhook) | B pre-flight result | C Approve & go live (HUMAN GATE, console tap) | D 30-min sweep (24 h / 72 h nudges, availability defaults, 48-h SLA stamp).
Every send goes through ONE channel router: WhatsApp via Meta Cloud API (templates in portal/spec/proposed-templates.json until automation-engineer adds them to automation/templates), email via Graph sendMail from HOWZIT_MAILBOX with bcc to HOWZIT_MAILBOX (one audit trail, 4.10 item 0).
Credentials by name only. Config from env: INTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET, FSCA_REGISTER_URL, SLOTS_API_URL, COMPLIANCE_PREFLIGHT_URL, GO_LIVE_HANDOFF_URL, PORTAL_URL, SUPABASE_URL, META_GRAPH_VERSION, PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_TEST_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_TEST_RECIPIENTS, DRY_RUN_SENDS, HOWZIT_MAILBOX, BRAND_ID. Replace REPLACE_WITH_W22_WORKFLOW_ID on import.
Human gates: the only one is Jonathan's Approve & go live. Nothing here publishes ads or touches payment.

parameters.query:
-- Idempotency (crm-gap A1 webhook_events). Zero rows back = replay: the lane stops here.
insert into public.webhook_events (source, external_id, received_at, signature_ok, payload_hash)
values ('w20', $1, now(), true, $2)
on conflict (source, external_id) do nothing
returning external_id;

select b.broker_id, b.adviser_name, b.practice_name, b.fsp_number, b.email, b.adviser_whatsapp, b.status,
       b.onboarding_step, coalesce(b.onboarding_progress,'{}'::jsonb) as onboarding_progress,
       b.last_seen_at, b.first_login_at, b.onboarding_last_progress_at, b.brand_id,
       (b.last_seen_at is not null and b.last_seen_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as in_portal
from public.brokers b where b.broker_id = $1::uuid;

nodes.name: Make magic link
nodes.notes: Supabase admin generate_link (service role). The portal route /m/:token exchanges hashed_token with verifyOtp({type:'magiclink', token_hash}). The raw link is never logged.

nodes.name: FSCA register lookup
nodes.notes: Expects the NORMALISED shape {found:boolean, status:string, register_name:string, categories:string[], checked_at:ISO}. How the FSCA register is queried is unknown offline: FSCA_REGISTER_URL may point at an adapter we host. needs_human NH-BS-09. No auth header by default (public register); add a credential here if the adapter needs one.

parameters.query:
-- attempts accumulate across re-submits; fsp_verified_at only on verified. Never touches routing_on.
update public.brokers set
  fsp_check = $2::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('attempts', coalesce((fsp_check->>'attempts')::int, 0) + 1),
  fsp_verified_at = case when $3 = 'verified' then now() else fsp_verified_at end
where broker_id = $1::uuid
returning broker_id, (fsp_check->>'attempts')::int as attempts;

-- Profile is done only when the required fields are saved AND the FSP is verified (headshot is not required).
update public.brokers set onboarding_progress = jsonb_set(coalesce(onboarding_progress,'{}'::jsonb), '{profile}', jsonb_build_object('status','done','done_at',now(),'by','system')),
       onboarding_last_progress_at = now()
where broker_id = $1::uuid and fsp_verified_at is not null
  and practice_name is not null and adviser_name is not null and adviser_whatsapp is not null and email is not null
  and bio_short is not null and coalesce(array_length(languages,1),0) > 0 and years_advising is not null
returning broker_id;

update public.brokers set onboarding_progress = jsonb_set(coalesce(onboarding_progress,'{}'::jsonb), '{profile}', jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','done_at',null,'by','system')) where broker_id = $1::uuid returning broker_id;

nodes.name: Verify slots (W04 GET /slots)
nodes.notes: W04 returns {slots:[{start,end}]} in Africa/Johannesburg. Internal auth header is a placeholder: swap for the signed-request scheme automation-engineer ships with W04 (INTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET signs page->n8n calls, 6B.5).

parameters.query:
update public.brokers set calendar_status = 'ok', next_free_slot_at = $2::timestamptz,
  onboarding_progress = jsonb_set(coalesce(onboarding_progress,'{}'::jsonb), '{calendar}', jsonb_build_object('status','done','done_at',now(),'by','system')),
  onboarding_last_progress_at = now()
where broker_id = $1::uuid returning broker_id;

nodes.name: Fetch signed PDF
nodes.notes: Short-lived signed URL from the private admin-documents bucket (payload.signed_url). The PDF is attached to the email only; never logged.

parameters.query:
-- onboarded = steps 2-6 done (profile+FSP verified, calendar, availability done|defaulted, agreement, card). Video never blocks.
update public.brokers set status = 'onboarded', onboarding_completed_at = now(), onboarding_last_progress_at = now()
where broker_id = $1::uuid and status = 'onboarding' and fsp_verified_at is not null
  and onboarding_progress->'profile'->>'status' = 'done'
  and onboarding_progress->'calendar'->>'status' = 'done'
  and onboarding_progress->'availability'->>'status' in ('done','defaulted')
  and onboarding_progress->'agreement'->>'status' = 'done'
  and onboarding_progress->'card'->>'status' = 'done'
returning broker_id, practice_name, extract(epoch from (now() - first_login_at))/3600 as hours_from_first_login;

nodes.name: Start compliance pre-flight

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ broker_id: $json.broker_id, run_id: 'pf-' + $json.broker_id + '-' + Date.now(), callback_url: $env.N8N_PUBLIC_URL + '/webhook/w20/preflight-result', checks: ['fsp_verified','consent_mode_set','intro_card_gate','calendar_slots','test_lead_e2e'] }) }}

nodes.notes: compliance-qa owns the checks (6.1 step 3). Async: the card comes back on /webhook/w20/preflight-result. test_lead_e2e uses an is_synthetic lead delivered only to Jonathan's test number. Auth header: internal signed request, same scheme as W04.

parameters.query: update public.brokers set preflight_run_id = $2, preflight_card = null where broker_id = $1::uuid returning broker_id;

-- Card shape: {run_id, ran_at, checks:[{id,label,pass,detail}], all_pass}. Ignore results for a stale run_id.
update public.brokers set preflight_card = $2::jsonb
where broker_id = $1::uuid and preflight_run_id = $3
returning broker_id, adviser_name, adviser_whatsapp, practice_name, status, preflight_card;
update public.brokers set status = 'ready_for_go_live' where broker_id = $1::uuid and status = 'onboarded' returning broker_id, adviser_name, adviser_whatsapp, practice_name;

-- Admin-only action: the console signs the request with the admin's uid. Preconditions: status ready_for_go_live and a pre-flight pass no older than 24 h.
select b.broker_id, b.status, b.practice_name, b.adviser_name, b.adviser_whatsapp, b.email,
       (b.status = 'ready_for_go_live' and coalesce((b.preflight_card->>'all_pass')::boolean,false)
        and (b.preflight_card->>'ran_at')::timestamptz > now() - interval '24 hours'
        and exists (select 1 from public.user_roles r where r.user_id = $2::uuid and r.role = 'admin')) as ok,
       case when b.status <> 'ready_for_go_live' then 'not_ready' when (b.preflight_card->>'ran_at')::timestamptz <= now() - interval '24 hours' then 'preflight_stale' else 'not_allowed' end as why
from public.brokers b where b.broker_id = $1::uuid;

nodes.name: Hand off to go-live step (W26/W16)
nodes.notes: Raises the media budget by the broker's media_share_zar via the Meta Marketing API, applies routing capacity, confirms CAPI/offline sets (6.1 step 5; ads-api-engineer + automation-engineer). Must be idempotent on request_id.

parameters.query: update public.brokers set status = 'ready_for_go_live', routing_on = false, approved_live_at = null where broker_id = $1::uuid returning broker_id;

parameters.jsCode:
const b = $('Activate broker').first().json;
return [{ json: { channel: 'w22', kind: 'signal', signal_key: 'go_live_handoff_failed', scope: 'broker:' + b.broker_id, severity: 'red', source: 'W20', what: 'Go-live hand-off failed for ' + b.practice_name, impact: 'Broker reverted to ready_for_go_live; nothing was announced to the broker', first_action: 'Check the media-budget / routing step in W26, then tap Approve & go live again', since: new Date().toISOString() } }];

parameters.query:
-- Clock = onboarding_last_progress_at. Nudges are idempotent per stall via onboarding_nudges.since. Broker #1 (assisted) is suppressed until suppress_until.
-- ready_for_go_live brokers are waiting on Jonathan, not on themselves: never nudged. After onboarded only the optional media step is nudged.
with b as (
  select *, case when (onboarding_nudges->>'since')::timestamptz is not distinct from onboarding_last_progress_at then coalesce(onboarding_nudges,'{}'::jsonb) else '{}'::jsonb end as n
  from public.brokers
  where brand_id = $1 and status in ('onboarding','onboarded')
    and (last_seen_at is null or last_seen_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')
    and (onboarding_nudges->>'suppress_until' is null or (onboarding_nudges->>'suppress_until')::timestamptz < now())
    and not (status = 'onboarded' and coalesce(onboarding_progress->'media'->>'status','todo') in ('done','skipped'))
)
select broker_id, adviser_name, adviser_whatsapp, email, status, onboarding_progress, onboarding_last_progress_at, practice_name,
  case when now() - onboarding_last_progress_at >= interval '72 hours' and n->>'72h' is null then '72h'
       when now() - onboarding_last_progress_at >= interval '24 hours' and n->>'24h' is null then '24h' end as due
from b
where onboarding_last_progress_at is not null
  and ( (now() - onboarding_last_progress_at >= interval '72 hours' and n->>'72h' is null)
     or (now() - onboarding_last_progress_at >= interval '24 hours' and n->>'24h' is null) );

nodes.name: Mark nudge sent (at-most-once)
nodes.notes: Runs only for the WhatsApp item that carries .mark (see IF below).

nodes.name: Default untouched availability (24 h after calendar)

parameters.query:
-- Step 4 pre-fills from the defaults (README). If untouched 24 h after the calendar step, it counts as defaulted so it can never stall go-live.
update public.brokers set onboarding_progress = jsonb_set(coalesce(onboarding_progress,'{}'::jsonb), '{availability}', jsonb_build_object('status','defaulted','done_at',now(),'by','system')), onboarding_last_progress_at = now()
where brand_id = $1 and status = 'onboarding' and onboarding_progress->'calendar'->>'status' = 'done'
  and (onboarding_progress->'calendar'->>'done_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '24 hours'
  and coalesce(onboarding_progress->'availability'->>'status','todo') in ('todo','doing')
returning broker_id;

-- Measure: onboarding complete within 48 h of first login. Stamped once; Jonathan sees it, the broker does not.
update public.brokers set onboarding_nudges = coalesce(onboarding_nudges,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('sla_48h_missed_at', now())
where brand_id = $1 and status = 'onboarding' and first_login_at < now() - interval '48 hours' and onboarding_nudges->>'sla_48h_missed_at' is null
returning broker_id, practice_name;

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map((i) => ({ json: { channel: 'w22', kind: 'signal', signal_key: 'onboarding_48h_missed', scope: 'broker:' + i.json.broker_id, severity: 'amber', source: 'W20', what: i.json.practice_name + ' passed 48 h since first login without finishing setup', impact: 'Misses the onboarding target (48 h, zero support calls)', first_action: 'Check where the broker is stuck; see the 72-h to-do', since: new Date().toISOString() } }));

nodes.name: Channel router
nodes.notes: Every builder in lanes A-D feeds this one router (a node may have many inputs).

nodes.name: WhatsApp: send template
nodes.notes: Same pattern as W22. Templates are UTILITY. A 4xx (template not approved yet) is logged, not retried, and never blocks the workflow: the portal still shows the next step.

nodes.name: Email: send via Graph (howzit@)
nodes.notes: Graph Mail.Send application permission on HOWZIT_MAILBOX only (NH-13). Bounces are read on the same mailbox by W05/W17.

parameters.query:
-- crm-gap A1: lead_activities as the single timeline (broker_id, workflow, actor_type, payload, idempotency_key). Needs lead_id nullable for broker rows (needs_human NH-BS-03).
insert into public.lead_activities (broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
values ($1::uuid, 'W20', 'system', $2, $3::jsonb, now(), $4)
on conflict (idempotency_key) do nothing returning broker_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.broker_id, $json.channel + '_' + $json.log_type, JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.channel, template: $json.template || null, subject: $json.subject || null, sent: !!$json.send, skip_reason: $json.skip_reason || null }), $json.idem + ':' + $json.channel ] }}

nodes.name: Raise alert (W22)
nodes.notes: W22 input: {kind:'signal'|'w20_go_live_ready', signal_key, scope:'broker:<id>', severity, what, impact, first_action, since} (same shape as W22's own signals). W22 owns dedupe (<=1 per 24 h per signal_key+scope), DND and the WhatsApp ops_alert / ops_gate templates. 'w20_go_live_ready' must map to the ops_gate template (needs W22 change: needs_human NH-BS-10).

main.node: Default untouched availability (24 h after calendar)
